summary.text: Rebecca Harned is the Democratic candidate for the New Hampshire State Senate, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She described herself in a Ballotpedia survey as a research scientist who lives in Sutton and serves on the Kearsarge Regional School District Municipal Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Rebecca Harned said she is the daughter of a service-disabled Air Force Vietnam veteran and graduated from Colby-Sawyer College before earning a master's degree.

She said she spent more than a decade in Washington, D.C., working under the Obama, Biden and Trump administrations on public safety and disaster preparedness initiatives, and returned to New Hampshire in 2017.
Harned said her campaign priorities include lowering property taxes, opposing a broad-based income or sales tax, and supporting public education and environmental stewardship.
